question: After how many days of missed payments does a federal Direct student loan go into default?
true_claim_text: federal Direct loans default after 270 days of missed payments
false_claim_text: federal Direct loans default after 90 days of missed payments
source: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid (studentaid.gov): a Direct Loan is in default when a payment is at least 270 days past due; at 90 days the delinquency is reported to credit bureaus but the loan is not yet in default.
